welcome.title: Welcome
body: Welcome to this little desktop.
It is not a real OS, but it deliberately looks like a 1990s PC: beveled buttons, a taskbar, draggable icons, and the occasional stuck mood.
Double-click desktop icons to open windows. The taskbar remembers open order — the newest sits further to the right.
If you are just browsing, pick an article on the left. There is no account and no submit button.

desktop.title: Desktop guide
body: Icons can be dragged. Move them to a comfortable grid; positions persist after refresh.
Change wallpapers in Settings: presets or your own uploads, stored locally. Prefer originals for a sharp fullscreen look.
Drag the title bar to move a window, drag edges to resize, use — to minimize, □ to maximize, and ✕ to close.
The address bar follows the focused window (e.g. /window/settings) via soft URL updates — no page reload. Refresh or share that URL to reopen the app; Back/Forward also retarget focus.
The taskbar has Start on the left, open windows in the middle, and theme, language, and decorative buttons on the right — the last ones are placeholders for now.

apps.title: Built-in apps
body: Minesweeper, Tetris, and Suika: classic games for zoning out.
Tile Match: layered cards — match three of a kind; fill the tray and you lose.
Settings: Display, Appearance, Taskbar, and Data. Data lets you export/import a JSON backup of local preferences and desktop state.
Document: the window you are reading. Offline content, no annotations saved.
Log: dated release notes — open the Log icon; Document also shows a short recent summary.
Notepad: create, edit, and delete plain-text notes in IndexedDB. Supports titles, word wrap, and Ctrl/⌘+S.
Paint: canvas doodling with palette, eraser, and shapes; works saved as PNG in IndexedDB.
Calculator: open from Start or the desktop. Supports arithmetic, parentheses, powers, square root, and simple memory keys.
K-Line Chart: USDT perpetual candles with period and main/sub indicators; market data from Binance public APIs.
Command Prompt: a simple DOS-style terminal to browse desktop/folder paths and open some apps.
Zhi Chat: SiliconFlow streaming chat; API key via .env; session stored in IndexedDB.
Image Viewer: upload local images or import from a URL; multi-select browsing; files stored in IndexedDB.

intro: Here are the latest updates. Open the Log app on the desktop for the full history.

2026-08-04.title: Games hub, puzzles & locales
items: Added Tile Match (sheep-style layered three-match) and fixed tray/board scale feedback that caused the slot bar to jitter.
Added a built-in Games folder: Minesweeper, Tetris, Suika, Tile Match, Image Puzzle, and Jigsaw live inside it (no longer separate desktop/Start Menu icons).
Added Image Puzzle: sliding puzzle (3×3 / 4×4 / 5×5) with built-in or uploaded images.
Added Jigsaw: pure Canvas tabbed pieces with neighbor relative snap into freely draggable clusters; no third-party DnD/physics libraries.
Capped the Start Menu Programs submenu at 400px max height (scroll when needed).
Added Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, German, and French; the taskbar language switcher supports seven locales.
Built-in app display names come from messages.apps only; register.ts no longer duplicates multilingual titles.
Added Sokoban: static JSON levels (levels.json), undo/restart/level select, listed in the Games folder.

2026-08-03.title: Mobile window apps
items: Added MasterDetail: on narrow screens, list and detail swap full-screen; desktop keeps a resizable split pane.
Settings, Zhi Chat, Notepad, Paint, Changelog, Image Viewer, and Documents now use mobile-friendly layouts with larger touch targets.
Paint toolbar wraps on small screens; the palette uses a responsive grid.
Mobile app host scrolls inside each app to avoid nested scroll conflicts.
Task Manager Programs / Applications open or switch on a single tap on touch (desktop still uses double-click).

New mini-game Suika (Watermelon Merge): Canvas rendering + custom circle physics (gravity, wall/ball collisions, friction, sleep, chain merges, danger-line game over) with no third-party physics library.
Suika: vertical drop-guide dashed line, shaded spheres with centered emoji glyphs, and local best-score persistence.
Suika physics: hard separation for deep penetration, stacked-weight wall slide-out, tunable fruit/ground friction.

2026-07-29.title: VFS, File Explorer & Recycle Bin
items: New virtual file system (VFS): notes, drawings, images, and wallpapers go through adapters instead of per-app IndexedDB stores.
Zhi Chat uses a dedicated multi-session IDB (sidebar create / rename / delete); chat requests send only the current message; .chat export/import under /Documents/Chats.
New File Explorer browses VFS paths; image context menu covers open, set wallpaper, copy/move, and trash.
Image Viewer is VFS-backed: open by path, uploads to /Pictures, URL paste is temporary preview only, delete uses soft trash.
Recycle Bin lists desktop soft-deletes and /Trash; desktop shows /Desktop file icons and opens by type on double-click.
Wallpapers move to VFS /Wallpapers (optional 3D); legacy migration helpers and empty IDB shells removed.

2026-07-27.title: IndexedDB & deploy
items: Notepad, Paint, wallpapers, Image Viewer, and Zhi Chat sessions now use browser IndexedDB instead of server .data — works on Vercel and other serverless hosts.
Zhi Chat API key moves to SILICONFLOW_API_KEY in .env / .env.local; in-app key entry is removed.
Chat proxy adds upstream and idle timeouts; context is sent from the client. Remote images go through /api/proxy-image then into IndexedDB.
Image uploads are capped at 10MB.
Production build uses plain next build (no Turbopack). Ignore package-lock.json and stick to Yarn’s lockfile.
Patched React Server Components CVEs; fixed a WinCloseIcon size prop type error that broke builds.

2026-07-26.title: Image Viewer & taskbar
items: New Image Viewer: multi-file upload, URL import, multi-select browsing, and thumbnails.
Taskbar window buttons support horizontal scrolling and drag-to-reorder; window management logic cleaned up.

2026-07-25.title: Screensaver
items: Screensaver can be enabled in Settings with idle timeout options (including Never).
Multiple dynamic canvas styles; idle trigger and localization polished.

2026-07-24.title: Multi-select & market feed
items: Desktop icons support marquee multi-select; drag-and-drop and context menus improved for batch actions.
K-line subscriptions use a managed WebSocket with sturdier connection and error handling.
Removed music features and APIs; UI and docs cleaned up accordingly.

2026-07-23.title: Window routes, backup & charts
items: Window routes: the focused app syncs to /window/{id} without reloading; refresh deep-links reopen it, and Back/Forward retarget focus.
Settings gains a Data section to export/import a JSON backup of local preferences and desktop state.
Settings sidebar is now Display, Appearance, Taskbar, and Data; the unused Desktop section was removed.
K-Line Chart for USDT perpetuals with periods and indicators; Notepad / Paint / K-line share a typed http client.
Zhi Chat ships with streaming chat, paged history + virtual scroll, and per-message delete; tray decor options simplified.

2026-07-21.title: Toast, snap & desktop polish
items: Global toasts for success / error / warning, slide in from the top-right, up to 10 at once.
Notepad CRUD feedback now uses toasts.
Desktop context menu: Arrange Icons — pack left or right, column-first.
Soft window edge snap (screen and other windows) for restored windows; drag farther to leave the edge; maximized windows ignored.
Folders (create/rename) and window OOP cleanup; removed the wallpaper-dimming overlay when apps are open.
Changelog dates are ISO + Intl formatting — no hard-coded display dates in copy.

2026-07-19.title: Theme, structure & Notepad
items: Fixed light/dark theme glitches in Settings panels, Document body, and status bars.
Theme colors now use CSS variables; Tailwind dark: variants follow next-themes class strategy.
Reorganized the repo: desktop apps under features/, helpers under lib/, shell under components/desktop/.
Split Settings into smaller section components for easier maintenance.
Shipped the Log window with dated release notes.
Notepad: plain-text notes stored in .data/notes with list, edit, save, and delete.
Paint: Canvas brush / eraser / line / rect / ellipse; PNGs stored in .data/drawings.

2026-07-18.title: Settings, clock & i18n
items: Settings expanded into Display, Appearance, Taskbar, and Desktop sections.
Added icon size, label visibility, placeholder icons, taskbar clock, and tray decor options.
Taskbar clock opens a read-only calendar (react-day-picker).
Wallpapers support local upload and URL import, with a draft preview before Apply.
Filled out Chinese and English copy for windows, desktop menus, Settings, and Document.

2026-07-16.title: Win95 UI kit
items: Extracted Win95-style UI: Button, Input, Select, Panel, Checkbox, and Context Menu.
Taskbar buttons show app icons and keep open order.

2026-07-12.title: Desktop v1
items: Win95-style desktop: draggable icons, stacked windows, and a taskbar.
Built-in Minesweeper and Tetris.
Light / dark theme and Chinese / English switching.
Document app with welcome and usage notes.
